title: Amores Perros (bc30)
synopsis: A fatalistic car crash in Mexico city sets off a chain of events in the lives of three people: a supermodel, a young man wanting to run off with his sister-in-law, and a homeless man. Their lives are catapulted into unforeseen situations instigated by the seemingly inconsequential destiny of a dog.

synopsis_lang.en: A fatalistic car crash in Mexico city sets off a chain of events in the lives of three people: a supermodel, a young man wanting to run off with his sister-in-law, and a homeless man. Their lives are catapulted into unforeseen situations instigated by the seemingly inconsequential destiny of a dog.
synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 若愛是頭狗，愛更是潑婦！養狗少年愛上兄嫂，一場禁戀害他付出鉅大、有婦之夫拋妻棄子，難逃天意弄人，忘情夫抱恨終生；老教授昔日當遊擊隊員，如今充當狙擊殺手，力挽離棄的女兒。三段故事一場撞狗意外，串連狗與主人，將愛和愛引伸出來的傷痛，以及人性的善與惡鞭撻得體無完膚。《狗男女的愛》揭開依拿力圖電影「死亡三部曲」的序幕，沒有《21克──生命可以有多重》的直白沉重，也不見《巴別塔》的無遠弗屆，卻插有凌厲且節奏明快的手搖鏡頭，風格兀然奠立。

cast: Gael García Bernal, Emilio Echevarría, Goya Toledo
